fact: The Referentiel general d'interoperabilite (RGI), adopted by Prime Minister's arrete of 23 May 2018, is described as a normative collection of protocols (communication rules, voice and file exchange protocols) ensuring compatibility between public administrations' information systems; a training seminar on it was held 15-17 October 2019.

The decree on the public administration's digital platforms, held in a capture dated 2 August 2024, makes a favourable opinion a condition of putting a platform into service, and the file for it includes a check that the platform respects the interoperability referential, which the decree says is adopted by order of the Prime Minister; the capture date is used, the passages giving no signing date.
